postal_system.full_code_rule: Preserve exactly five digits including leading zeroes. Deutsche Post assignment and licensed delivery-area geometry remain independent evidence; a PLZ alone does not identify a house number, building, recipient or deliverability.
postal_system.postcode_area_rule: Use a pinned Deutsche Post Direkt DATAFACTORY GEOCODE or BKG PLZ contract artifact as authoritative Polygon or MultiPolygon evidence for five-digit delivery postcodes. Large-recipient, P.O. Box and other non-delivery-area codes remain non-areal unless equally authoritative geometry proves otherwise.
postal_system.address_rule: Use pinned GA or HK-DE address-coordinate artifacts for street, house number, PLZ, locality, administrative keys, coordinate quality and source edition. A house coordinate is an official address position, not a building footprint.
postal_system.building_rule: Use HU-DE or LoD2-DE geometry as exact building evidence only through a source-defined object identifier or explicit crosswalk. Shared AGS, containment or nearest distance is candidate evidence and never an exact address-to-building link.
postal_system.admin_rule: Use pinned BKG VG25 administrative identifiers and boundaries for country, Land, Regierungsbezirk, Kreis and Gemeinde context. Administrative geometry never becomes PLZ geometry.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Public AGID resolution can display official civic address and building context but excludes recipient, resident, owner, forwarding, shipment, customer and non-public register data.
postal_system.rights_rule: Deutsche Post DATAFACTORY, BKG PLZ, GA/HK-DE, HU-DE and LoD2-DE artifacts remain contract-partitioned. No original or transformed restricted rows or geometry are published without a rights receipt explicitly permitting that artifact and use.
postal_system.territory_rule: The DE pack covers German sovereign territory. Austrian areas reachable only through Germany and carrying a German routing code remain separately flagged cross-border exceptions and are not silently published as German territory.

exception_classes.rule: Return pinned Deutsche Post Direkt five-digit delivery-area Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry while keeping operator assignment, geometry product, terms and edition separate.
Represent a Großempfänger PLZ as an organization or routing record; never invent a surrounding residential polygon.
Represent Postfach and facility routing as non-area records unless the licensed source explicitly supplies authoritative geometry for that class.
Preserve the GA/HK-DE address row, administrative keys, coordinate quality and source edition; do not present the point as a building outline.
Promote HU-DE or LoD2-DE geometry only through a source object identifier or reviewed explicit crosswalk. Containing and nearby features remain candidates.
Any surface generated from address points, streets or administrative boundaries is derived_geometry, opt-in and never branded as a Deutsche Post or BKG PLZ polygon.
Keep foreign sovereign geometry outside the DE country artifact even when Deutsche Post routing assigns a German code.

quality_gates.pass: Every source has a pinned release or receipt, digest, attribution, access and contract class, schema, CRS, state partition and transformation method.
Deutsche Post assignment, licensed PLZ geometry, address coordinates, building geometry, administration and AGID indexes remain separate evidence.
Polygon and multipolygon geometry is valid and checked for unexplained overlaps, gaps, islands, invalid codes, multipart loss and national-border leakage.
Every code is classified as delivery-area, large-recipient, P.O. Box, facility, cross-border, unknown or contract-only; absence from the area product never creates official geometry.
Every promoted address preserves street, house number, PLZ/locality, administrative keys, source quality, coordinate provenance, state partition and release time.
Every exact address-to-building edge has a source-defined object identifier or reviewed explicit crosswalk; AGS, containment and proximity alone remain candidates.
Public results contain no recipient, resident, owner, forwarding, shipment, customer or non-public register attributes.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, postcode classes and legal blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

A current complete rights-reviewed German five-digit delivery-postcode assignment denominator and postcode-specific Polygon/MultiPolygon release is pinned by edition, validity, schema, coverage, authority, terms and SHA-256, published as an approved immutable artifact, and passes the real DE AGID loader, API and app path for normalization, ambiguity, geometry validity, map fit, translucent fill, visible outline, provenance, loading, no-result, failure, clear and re-search. Deutsche Post/BKG delivery areas remain distinct from administrative boundaries and exact building geometry; large-recipient, P.O. box, organization and other non-area classes plus Austrian areas routed through Germany receive no invented surface. Test data, synthetic fixtures and metadata alone never establish M2.
Topology, identity, privacy, territory, freshness and holdout gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
